sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D environment MATERIAL ATLAS for Torii & Hutukara, match the approved warm-window purple cyberpunk JRPG street reference. EXACTLY 4 columns by2 rows =8 equal square swatches, row-major order. Each swatch is one square of pure flat material, fully opaque inside, surrounded by generous genuinely TRANSPARENT gutters; no black grid, no text, no labels. Treat the reference as PALETTE / surface style only, NEVER reproduce its houses, lamps, pipes, railings, furniture or scene layout inside swatches. Detailed visible hard square pixel clusters, 16-bit pixel art, nearest-neighbor look, limited coherent palette, consistent top-down ground-plane lighting. Pattern must continue naturally across opposite edges without picture borders or framing; uniform material statistics, no centered motifs. Every swatch remains quiet enough to clearly see characters and boss telegraphs at 24px tiles. No huge symbols, circles, signage, machines, plants, buildings, shadow objects, gradients or photo/3D smoothing. Row1 left-to-right: dry fine-grained graphite-violet asphalt; same asphalt with subtle sparse cyan/magenta wet reflection fragments; warm grey-violet small regular cobblestone sidewalk; dark violet alley stone slabs. Row2: deep teal-purple canal water with subtle short horizontal cyan ripples; worn purple-grey riveted flush metal floor panels with copper seams; dark dusty-blue open sky with very faint diffuse lavender cloud haze; dark indigo-violet empty abyss with sparse tiny distant pinprick stars. All samples quiet/low contrast, no dominant symbols.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for Torii & Hutukara, existing 2D top-down 3/4 16-bit JRPG, axis-aligned square tile world. Match approved RUA_DISTRITO_PROPOSTA.png and existing detailed building/prop sprites. Visible deliberate square-pixel clusters, dark clean contour, consistent pixel density; no smooth 3D, photographic textures, blur, antialias halos, baked UI or characters. Exact equal invisible grid; generous transparent gutters; real transparent RGBA canvas. Each object fully isolated, centered in its cell, ground contact at consistent baseline. Preserve requested item order. No text, labels, letters, watermark, mask decorations, floating objects or giant glows. Neon is local cyan/magenta; inhabited light amber; worn graphite-violet metal. Bright warning colors reserved for gameplay. Sixteen orthographic-on-grid ground overlay pieces, true transparent background. Continuous purple-gray stone curb and narrow copper drainage channel, four cardinal edges then four convex and four concave corners, two painted worn cream pedestrian crossings, one flush metal drain, one slim entrance inlay. Match street pavers/asphalt family, subtle neon reflection only. No buildings, thick walls, black rectangles, giant cables or text. All cardinal/corner edges share the same profile and must connect; no fake separators baked into textures. Grid 4 columns by 4 rows. Ordered cells, left to right top to bottom: curb_n, curb_e, curb_s, curb_w, curb_outer_ne, curb_outer_se, curb_outer_sw, curb_outer_nw, curb_inner_ne, curb_inner_se, curb_inner_sw, curb_inner_nw, crossing_horizontal, crossing_vertical, service_drain, threshold_inlay.
Production constraints: Orthographic top-down 3/4 JRPG, not isometric diamond art. All cells have consistent origin and scale. No captions, no opaque backplates around props, no floor rectangle under an isolated object. Respect aspect ratio. Fit complete sprites with generous transparent gutters. Exact row/column count as specified.

Cloud pieces must fit SQUARE cells with nearly square planform. Center tiles fill nearly the whole square with calm ivory cloud top, not an isolated ball. Northern/eastern/southern/western edges have transparency only on the named exterior side; convex corners have transparency on both named exterior sides. The other inner edges must meet top tiles with matching continuous cloudy surface. Concave cells are filled cloud with a small transparent notch at the named corner. No floating mountains, no circles or pedestal bases.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production PNG RGBA SPRITE SHEET for 16-bit top-down JRPG Torii & Hutukara. TRUE alpha=0 TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND everywhere outside the isolated objects. No white, gray, checkerboard, colored backing or drop-shadow rectangle. EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows =12 separate objects in equal square cells with very wide fully transparent gutters. Hard visible square-pixel clusters, detailed graphite-violet metal with brass screws, subtle magenta/cyan/amber edge lights; cozy cyberpunk, no blur/photoreal/3D. NO buildings, facades, walls, roofs, shops, pillars, doors, gate arches, furniture, plants, characters or environment scenes. NO letters, writing, numbers, captions, logos or fake text. ROW1: four SHORT WIDE HORIZONTAL rectangular hanging signboards ONLY, width:height ratio about4:1, deep flat dark-purple EMPTY CENTER (70 percent width) reserved for text rendered in code; first has magenta trim, second amber/copper trim, third warm golden trim, fourth cyan trim. ROW2: fifth short wide signboard with violet trim and same empty center; sixth small standalone LEFT-pointing arrow metal sign; seventh standalone RIGHT-pointing arrow sign; eighth flat OPEN DOORSTEP FLOOR PLATE seen slightly from above, low brass edges and cyan inlay, no vertical structure. ROW3: ninth same low doorstep floor plate with a narrow magenta CLOSED stripe (not a door); tenth low elevator BOARDING PAD, rectangular ground platform with cyan corner brackets, no surrounding tower or railings; eleventh small horizontal canal quay EDGE segment with low metal railing at BACK and transparent FRONT so water/floor can show through; twelfth matching quay edge with mirrored end cap. Each object fully fits its own cell, same material style. These are compact ATTACHABLE sign panels and GROUND TRIMS to be layered onto EXISTING buildings, not replacement buildings. Most of every cell must remain pure transparent alpha0.
